sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test imports
sections.what: Brings in the test tools, the error types, the share service and the services that will be faked.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code.

sections.name: ShareService (Doctor Sharing Portal & Cryptographic Tokens) (part 1)
sections.title: Fake setup before each test
sections.what: Before each test, builds fake database, audit and notification objects, and the test module that uses them.
sections.why: Likely reason: tests run without a real database or notification service.
sections.watch_out: The fake create and update functions echo the input back, so the tests may miss mismatches with the real database schema.

sections.name: ShareService (Doctor Sharing Portal & Cryptographic Tokens) (part 2)
sections.title: Create and view success tests
sections.what: Checks that creating a share returns a 64 character token and writes an access granted audit entry. Checks that viewing returns the patient name, sends the doctor access alert, and writes a view audit entry.
sections.why: Likely reason: these are the core promises to the patient.
sections.watch_out: The token test checks length only, not that the value is random or unique.

sections.name: ShareService (Doctor Sharing Portal & Cryptographic Tokens) (part 3)
sections.title: Revoked and expired refusal tests
sections.what: Checks that viewing a revoked share is refused and that viewing an expired share is refused.
sections.why: Likely reason: stops access once the patient cuts it off or the time limit passes.
sections.watch_out: No test covers a token that does not exist, so that path is untested.

summary: Automated tests for the doctor share service, using fake database, audit and notification objects.
purpose: Checks that links get a long token, that viewing works and notifies the patient, and that revoked or expired links are refused.
why: Likely reason: protects the most sensitive access path in the app.
how: Sets fake objects before each test, then runs checks for creating a share, viewing an active share, and refusing a revoked and an expired share.
inputs: Test data defined inside the file.
risks: No test checks that revoke works, that an unknown token returns not found, or that each resource type shows only what was shared. The token test checks length only.
debug: Run the spec and read the failed check. Missing fake functions show up as errors naming them.
